6282.title: Picker host priority selects the remote server
6282.rootCauseOneLine: The picker prefers a connected remote primary over an enrolled local client, excluding the client checkout and suppressing its native picker.

prReviews.topFinding: Closed without merge; includes client preference plus unrelated duplicate-path changes; not executed.
Folder validation changes do not alter picker host selection; not executed.

6282.proposedFix: Prefer an enrolled connected helper host, preserve primary/helper fallbacks, and resolve the selected host name from the host list.
6282.caveats: Two real React-hook test runs reproduce the logic failure. Windows desktop UI and the native OS dialog are not end-to-end verified.
